bio.text: Andrea Stewart-Cousins, a Democrat, has represented District 35 in the New York State Senate since 2007 and has been Senate majority leader since January 9, 2019, according to Ballotpedia.
From 1996 to 2006 she served on the Westchester County Board of Legislators, and in 1992 she was appointed Yonkers's director of community affairs.
She was born in New York City in 1950 and earned a bachelor's degree from Pace University in 1986 and a master's degree there in 2008.
Before public service she worked at New York Telephone/AT&T for 13 years and later in journalism and education.
